rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It executed returns without confirming the specific items and actions with the user before making order-changing writes. It performed multiple return actions: attempted a credit-card refund for one tablet, then processed duplicate gift-card returns for the same item, and also initiated a separate return on a different order—contradicting the user’s request to return only the more expensive of the two tablets. The final message states one tablet refunded to gift card and the other to credit card, which is inconsistent with the tool calls (duplicate returns on the same item and an extra return on another order) and thus not reliably supported. While the agent did attempt to identify the user and retrieve orders, the lack of confirmation, incorrect scope of returns, and contradictory refund outcomes violate the pass criteria.
